terms.label: Supplier
terms.value: Northwind Analytics Ltd, registered in England
terms.quote: This Services Agreement is made between Northwind Analytics Ltd, a company registered in England (the "Supplier"), and Harbor Foods Ltd (the "Client").

terms.label: Client
terms.quote: This Services Agreement is made between Northwind Analytics Ltd, a company registered in England (the "Supplier"), and Harbor Foods Ltd (the "Client").

terms.label: Effective date
terms.quote: 1.1 This Agreement starts on 1 February 2026 (the "Effective Date") and continues for 12 months.

terms.label: Initial term
terms.quote: 1.1 This Agreement starts on 1 February 2026 (the "Effective Date") and continues for 12 months.

terms.label: Supplier obligation
terms.value: Monthly sales dashboard and one analysis report each quarter
terms.quote: 2.1 The Supplier shall deliver a monthly sales dashboard and one analysis report each quarter.

terms.label: Client obligation
terms.value: Give read access to the sales database within 10 working days of the Effective Date
terms.quote: 2.2 The Client shall give the Supplier read access to its sales database within 10 working days of the Effective Date.

terms.label: Monthly fee
terms.quote: 3.1 The Client shall pay a fee of £4,500 per month, plus VAT.

terms.label: Payment terms
terms.value: Invoices due within 30 days; late interest 4% above the Bank of England base rate
terms.quote: 3.2 Invoices are payable within 30 days of the invoice date. Late payments carry interest at 4% above the Bank of England base rate.

terms.label: Automatic renewal
terms.value: Renews for 12 months unless notice of non-renewal is given 60 days before the term ends
terms.quote: 4.1 This Agreement renews automatically for further periods of 12 months unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before the end of the current term.

terms.label: Termination for convenience
terms.quote: 5.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement with 90 days' written notice.

terms.label: Termination for breach
terms.value: Immediate, if a material breach is not remedied within 14 days of notice
terms.quote: 5.2 Either party may terminate immediately if the other commits a material breach that is not remedied within 14 days of written notice.

terms.label: Confidentiality period
terms.value: During the term and 3 years after it ends
terms.quote: 6.1 Each party shall keep the other's confidential information secret during the term and for 3 years after it ends.

terms.label: Liability cap
terms.value: Supplier's liability limited to fees paid in the 12 months before the claim
terms.quote: 7.1 The Supplier's total liability under this Agreement is limited to the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim.

terms.label: Governing law
terms.quote: 8.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

notes: The agreement renews automatically unless notice is given at least 60 days before the end of the term.

terms.label: Party
terms.quote: Dated 15 March 2026 between Alpine Robotics GmbH and Ostara Labs Inc.

terms.label: Party
terms.quote: Dated 15 March 2026 between Alpine Robotics GmbH and Ostara Labs Inc.

terms.label: Date of agreement
terms.quote: Dated 15 March 2026 between Alpine Robotics GmbH and Ostara Labs Inc.

terms.label: Use and disclosure
terms.value: Use only for the Purpose; no disclosure without prior written consent
terms.quote: Each party shall use the other's Confidential Information only for the Purpose and shall not disclose it to any third party without prior written consent.

terms.label: Term
terms.value: Two years from the date above; clause 2 obligations survive five years after it ends
terms.quote: This Agreement remains in force for two (2) years from the date above. The obligations in clause 2 survive for five (5) years after it ends.

terms.label: Both parties' obligation
terms.value: Return or destroy confidential information within 10 days on request
terms.quote: On request, each party shall return or destroy all Confidential Information within 10 days.

terms.label: Governing law
terms.quote: This Agreement is governed by Swiss law, and the courts of Zurich have jurisdiction.

terms.label: Landlord
terms.quote: Landlord: Greenway Properties LLC.

terms.label: Tenant
terms.quote: Tenant: Bluebird Café LLC.

terms.label: Start date
terms.quote: The lease begins on May 1, 2026 and ends on April 30, 2031.

terms.label: End date
terms.quote: The lease begins on May 1, 2026 and ends on April 30, 2031.

terms.label: Base rent
terms.value: $3,250.00 per month, due on the first day of each month
terms.quote: Base rent is $3,250.00 per month, due on the first day of each month.

terms.label: Rent increase
terms.value: 3% on each anniversary of the start date
terms.quote: Rent increases by 3% on each anniversary of the start date.

terms.label: Security deposit
terms.quote: Tenant shall pay a deposit of $6,500 before taking possession.

terms.label: Tenant early termination
terms.value: After year three, six months' notice plus two months' rent
terms.quote: Tenant may end the lease after the third year by giving six months' notice and paying two months' rent as a fee.

terms.label: Governing law
terms.quote: The laws of the State of Oregon apply.

terms.label: Prestataire
terms.quote: Entre la société Atelier Lumière SARL (le Prestataire) et Maison Verte SAS (le Client).

terms.label: Client
terms.quote: Entre la société Atelier Lumière SARL (le Prestataire) et Maison Verte SAS (le Client).

terms.label: Prise d'effet
terms.quote: Le contrat prend effet le 1er septembre 2026 pour une durée d'un an.

terms.label: Durée
terms.quote: Le contrat prend effet le 1er septembre 2026 pour une durée d'un an.

terms.label: Prix
terms.quote: Le Client verse 12.500,00 € HT, payables en deux fois.

terms.label: Résiliation
terms.value: Lettre recommandée, préavis de deux mois
terms.quote: Chaque partie peut résilier le contrat par lettre recommandée avec un préavis de deux mois.

terms.label: Initial period
terms.value: One year from the date of the order form
terms.quote: The Customer subscribes to the CloudDesk Pro plan for an initial period of one year starting on the date of the order form.

terms.label: Automatic renewal
terms.value: Successive one-year periods at the then-current list price
terms.quote: The subscription renews automatically for successive one-year periods at the then-current list price.

terms.label: How to stop renewal
terms.value: Cancel in the admin console at least 30 days before the renewal date
terms.quote: To stop renewal, the Customer must cancel in the admin console at least 30 days before the renewal date.

terms.label: Billing
terms.quote: Fees are billed annually in advance and are non-refundable.

notes: The fee amount and the start date are not in this text: they are in the order form, which is not included.

terms.label: Company liability
terms.value: Excluded in full for any loss
terms.quote: The Company's liability for any loss, however caused, is excluded in full.

terms.label: Consultant liability
terms.quote: The Consultant's liability is unlimited.

terms.label: Consultant waiver
terms.value: Consultant waives all claims, including for unpaid fees
terms.quote: The Consultant waives all claims against the Company, including claims for unpaid fees.

terms.label: Company termination
terms.quote: The Company may terminate this agreement at any time without notice;

terms.label: Consultant termination
terms.quote: the Consultant may not terminate before the project ends.

terms.label: Governing law
terms.quote: This agreement is governed by the laws of Delaware.

notes: The liability terms are one-sided: the Company's liability is excluded in full while the Consultant's is unlimited. Have this reviewed.
